'''Alternate Image''' ('''AI''') is a Decipher printing of a rare with different artwork and the same title and game text. That printing is titled ''Title (AI)''.

Decipher packed Alternate Image rares in three Episode I expansions: [[Tatooine]], [[Coruscant]], and [[Theed Palace]] (nine in each set). Earlier Decipher expansions did not pack AI rares. The Players Committee later issued virtual Alternate Image cards in GEMP; those are a separate product.

== Tatooine ==

[[Tatooine]] packed nine alternate-image rares (5 Light, 4 Dark). Each rare appears eight times on the rare sheet; two of the eight are the AI version (except [[Boonta Eve Podrace]], nine times per side).<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

== Coruscant ==

[[Coruscant]] packed nine alternate-image rares (6 Light, 3 Dark). Each rare appears four times on the rare sheet; one of the four is the AI version (except [[Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber]] Light and [[Dioxis]] Dark, five times each).<ref name="encyc" />

== Theed Palace ==

[[Theed Palace]] packed nine alternate-image rares (6 Light, 3 Dark). Each rare appears six times on the rare sheet; two of the six are the AI version (except [[Naboo Celebration]] Light and [[Master, Destroyers!]] Dark, seven times each).<ref name="encyc" />
